# iosxe_voice_class_codec (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class Codec configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_codec" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class codec tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `preferences` (Attributes List) Set priority order for using this codec (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--preferences))

<a id="nestedatt--preferences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `preferences`

Read-Only:

- `codec` (String)
- `preference` (Number) Priority order (1 = Highest)
